_comment: Alert Engine policy for the FloodGuard MVP. Edit this file to retune cooldowns or which channels fire per zone — no code changes required, just restart the server. 'outside' and 'green' never generate emergency alerts, so they have no entries below.

cooldown_minutes._comment: Minimum time before an identical (user + location + zone) alert may resend. Also doubles as the 're-alert interval' for a user who remains in the same zone.
